items.title: Tencent-Hunyuan/Hy-Memory: MemHub v1.0.8
items.summary_en:
## MemHub 1.0.8 (build 49)

Pins [`hy-memory==2.0.17`](https://pypi.org/project/hy-memory/2.0.17/) with offline Qdrant/bm25 FastEmbed assets in the frozen Core, plus an explicit stopped-writer `bm25-maintenance` CLI.

### Platforms
- Linux x64 / arm64 Runtime
- macOS arm64 App (DMG) and Runtime

###
